name: bm25_focused_clause
reason: Remove function words and generic contract-question scaffolding from the clause query while preserving negation and keeping document routing unchanged.

name: bm25_document_then_clause
reason: Use the full question to identify a contract, then rank passages in that inferred contract using only the clause question; prevent repeated party names from dominating clause scores.

name: bm25_chunks_500
reason: Shorter passages may separate relevant clauses from nearby distracting text.

name: bm25_chunks_1500
reason: Longer passages may cover answer spans split across chunk boundaries.

name: bm25_b_030
reason: Less length normalization may reduce ranking bias toward short fragments.

name: bm25_k1_080
reason: Earlier term-frequency saturation may reduce the influence of repeated words.

name: bm25_threshold_50
reason: A higher score threshold may reduce false returns, subject to recall and false-abstention guardrails.
